comparison.objective: Torque a busbar lug bolt to a click-wrench signal without overshoot; candidate sets and locks a damper, then validates stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests steady wrench pulling and rapid cessation at a one-shot mechanical click. Candidate tests recessed bit insertion, captive screw loosening/tightening, fine collar rotation, moved-socket reacquisition, and iterative test cycles.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires a click and peak torque within 90–110%, with no reversal or overtorque and hands clear. Candidate requires two consecutive safe stops plus force, travel, velocity, rebound, and ≤2° drift compliance.
comparison.reason: Both penalize excessive force and use a tool, but PR is single-event torque control; the candidate's core outcome is tuning and retaining dynamic energy absorption.
